mapper.select: SELECT t.*, t.SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID source_id, s.NAME source_name, s.CODE source_code, s.ICON source_icon, m.ICON model_icon, m.TYPE model_type, m.NAME model_name, m.CODE model_code, v.STATUS model_version_status, COALESCE(rv.VERSION_NO, v.VERSION_NO) model_version_no, COALESCE(u.NICK_NAME, u.USER_NAME) responsible_person_name, u.PHONENUMBER responsible_person_phone, cu.PHONENUMBER createPhoneNumber FROM INGEST_TASK t LEFT JOIN INGEST_SOURCE_SYSTEM s ON s.ID = t.SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID LEFT JOIN MODEL_BASE m ON m.ID = t.MODEL_ID LEFT JOIN MODEL_BASE parent ON parent.ID = m.PARENT_ID AND parent.DEL_FLAG = '0' LEFT JOIN MODEL_VERSION v ON v.ID = COALESCE(m.VERSION_ID, parent.VERSION_ID) AND v.DEL_FLAG = '0' LEFT JOIN MODEL_BASE published_model ON published_model.ID = CASE WHEN m.PARENT_ID IS NULL OR m.PARENT_ID = 0 THEN m.ID ELSE m.PARENT_ID END AND published_model.DEL_FLAG = '0' LEFT JOIN MODEL_INSTANCE published_instance ON published_instance.ID = published_model.PUBLISHED_INSTANCE_ID AND published_instance.MODEL_ID = published_model.ID AND published_instance.STATUS = 'SUCCEEDED' LEFT JOIN MODEL_VERSION rv ON rv.ID = published_instance.MODEL_VERSION_ID AND rv.MODEL_ID = published_model.ID AND rv.DEL_FLAG = '0' LEFT JOIN SYSTEM_USER u ON u.USER_ID = t.RESPONSIBLE_USER_ID AND u.DEL_FLAG = '0' LEFT JOIN SYSTEM_USER cu ON cu.USER_ID = t.CREATOR_ID AND cu.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE t.ID = #{id} AND t.DEL_FLAG = '0'
